events.text: Hi! I'm Alba. I'm here to keep you company these days with your baby. You don't have to download anything: I write to you right here. 💛
I can see these days have been heavy. You are not alone, and what you feel matters. If you want to talk to someone, the TLC-MAMA line is available for you.
3 a.m. and awake again. You posted anonymously in the Circle; a promotora answered with a short audio and another mom left you a tip.
Soaking a pad in an hour is a warning sign. Call your doctor now.
Gentle pelvic floor exercises, at your own pace and within your cuarentena of rest. If something doesn't feel right, stop.
It's been three weeks. A good time to call your clinic and book your appointment. Have you called yet?
Your appointment is coming up. Check your list: childcare, transport and saved questions.
Your one-page summary is ready to take to the appointment.
Today is your appointment. You've got this! Bring your summary and your questions.
After the appointment: did you go? Tell us and we'll celebrate with you.
